displayIdentity.body: Paul witnesses in Rome without hindrance. When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them about Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening. preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things about the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
